g.text: USB-C power enters U1 only. No battery. Camera removed; microSD unused.

g.desc: USB-C power enters U1 only. No battery. Camera removed; microSD unused.

g.text: U2 onboard screw terminal + -> LS1 +; terminal - -> LS1 -.

g.desc: U2 onboard screw terminal + -> LS1 +; terminal - -> LS1 -.

g.text: LS1: Visaton K40 8 ohm / 1 W. Both BTL wires float: never connect to GND.

g.desc: LS1: Visaton K40 8 ohm / 1 W. Both BTL wires float: never connect to GND.

g.text: R4 sets 3 dB gain. R5-R7 series damping. F1 protects amplifier branch only.

g.desc: R4 sets 3 dB gain. R5-R7 series damping. F1 protects amplifier branch only.

g.text: GPIO4 HIGH turns Q1 ON and silences U2. R3 defaults to mute during boot.

g.desc: GPIO4 HIGH turns Q1 ON and silences U2. R3 defaults to mute during boot.

g.text: J1 harness -> normally-open panel switch. J2 pin1 -> LED anode, pin2 -> cathode.

g.desc: J1 harness -> normally-open panel switch. J2 pin1 -> LED anode, pin2 -> cathode.
